unknown_parameters.title: Executable weave topology
unknown_parameters.detail: Bead IDs, ordered hole passages, crossings, loop membership, shared beads and free-end roles; photos are insufficient.

unknown_parameters.title: Bead and bore geometry
unknown_parameters.detail: Qualified dimensions, tolerances, hole axes/edge finish and component count. Across-hole shell r_star is not bore diameter.

unknown_parameters.title: Material identity and diameter
unknown_parameters.detail: Actual product/lot, diameter and handling envelope; nylon source conflict stays recorded.

unknown_parameters.title: Specimen allocation and reuse
unknown_parameters.detail: Preparation identities, component lots, replicate count and reset/reuse policy; no historical specimen count is recovered.

unknown_parameters.title: Mobile robot feasibility
unknown_parameters.detail: Embodiment, grasps, tool interfaces, carriers, force envelope, reachability, collision/IK and supported navigation require qualification.

unknown_parameters.title: Discrete pretension schedule
unknown_parameters.detail: Ranges and isolated labels do not imply all levels; supply ordered values with mass/tension convention and actual readback.

unknown_parameters.title: Pulley and end fixtures
unknown_parameters.detail: Travel, alignment, attachment, friction checks, mass restraint and safe transfer limits.

unknown_parameters.title: Qualified manual-like tensioning endpoint
unknown_parameters.detail: Source manual pretension is not numerical; supply bounded action and record resulting state without inventing a source force.

unknown_parameters.title: Knot/crimp/clamp qualification
unknown_parameters.detail: Source termination class is known in some routes; tooling, knot path, crimp die and holding checks are missing.

unknown_parameters.title: Mechanical fixture drawings
unknown_parameters.detail: Plate, ring clamps, stage, mounts, supports and indenter-to-specimen alignment.

unknown_parameters.title: Mechanical loading program
unknown_parameters.detail: Missing speed/stroke/dwell/contact-zero/safety/abort settings supplied per route; no cross-route rate transfer.

unknown_parameters.title: Acquisition and calibration
unknown_parameters.detail: Load cell, sign/units, sampling, calibration, zero, saturation limits and immutable record receipt.

unknown_parameters.title: Motion capture calibration
unknown_parameters.detail: Lens/view geometry, front/bottom transforms, frame rate, visibility, time offset and tracking uncertainty.

unknown_parameters.title: Tracking-cycle selection
unknown_parameters.detail: Identify one actual cycle before analysis; do not treat one tracked cycle as another sample.

unknown_parameters.title: Analysis and aggregation rules
unknown_parameters.detail: Fit windows, smoothing, extrema, interpolation, uncertainty/SD convention and exclusions must be explicit.

unknown_parameters.title: Measured tension versus difference
unknown_parameters.detail: Resolve definition of plateau T_star for capstan fit; retain T_sensor, T0 and difference as separate fields.

unknown_parameters.title: Shell projection convention
unknown_parameters.detail: Resolve alpha=0 versus sin(alpha) denominator ambiguity and define near-singularity handling.

unknown_parameters.title: Cross-section and clamp model
unknown_parameters.detail: Measured A, gauge zero, elastic fit region, compliance model and actual per-clamp correction.

unknown_parameters.title: Unreported repeat counts
unknown_parameters.detail: Positive integer schedule or explicitly no requested repeats; null cannot become empty success.

unknown_parameters.title: Acetal size and bore matching
unknown_parameters.detail: Exact bead radii, drilled bore geometry, quality checks and matched conditions.

unknown_parameters.title: Enclosed fabrication service
unknown_parameters.detail: Qualified drawings, approved material, job ID, guards and part-quality receipt; no invented CAD.

unknown_parameters.title: Contained failure endpoint
unknown_parameters.detail: Force/displacement limits, failure definition, containment and damage quarantine.

unknown_parameters.title: Column program ordering
unknown_parameters.detail: Reference length, neutral state, extension/compression ordering, dwell and end-bead grip geometry.

unknown_parameters.title: Qualified SMA wire specification
unknown_parameters.detail: Actual material/diameter, resistance and manufacturer-supported electrical/thermal envelope.

unknown_parameters.title: Electrical and thermal safety
unknown_parameters.detail: Current limit, isolation, temperature feedback, heating duration, cool/reset criterion and service interlock.

unknown_parameters.title: Three-point fixture/program
unknown_parameters.detail: Support span, nose radius, stroke, contact zero and linear-fit window; off/on sequence and cooling policy.

unknown_parameters.title: Catenary mesh and dome pattern
unknown_parameters.detail: Source geometry file, mesh parameters, pattern and total bead count are absent.

unknown_parameters.title: Dome thread conflict resolution
unknown_parameters.detail: Nylon body/Methods versus polyester caption; actual supplied choice must be labeled.

unknown_parameters.title: Cone patch and point loader
unknown_parameters.detail: Patch extent, hole orientation, boundary, point-contact tool and reset/inversion path.

unknown_parameters.title: Reconfiguration targets and observation
unknown_parameters.detail: Physical orientation/contact regions, actuation limits, release window, support and target list; no invented state quota.

unknown_parameters.title: Qualified tomography service settings
unknown_parameters.detail: Voltage/current, projections, exposure, voxel size, reconstruction and guarded scan authorization.

unknown_parameters.title: CT platform and glue preparation
unknown_parameters.detail: Platform mapping/dimensions, adhesive/cure, fixture position and state-retention checks; SI details govern resolved material branch.

unknown_parameters.title: CT state and sample linkage
unknown_parameters.detail: Actual measured state and mechanical-test link if any; same sample cannot be presumed.

unknown_parameters.title: Tomography analysis definition
unknown_parameters.detail: ROI, crop, slab, threshold/segmentation, centerline length definition and uncertainty.

unknown_parameters.title: Archive/reset acceptance
unknown_parameters.detail: Safe load-off state, material inspection, traceable storage and station reset criteria.
